lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 8 to 10 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs with centroids aligned in a semi-rectilinear grid pattern across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like nodal structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A non-uniform, high-intensity white patch/lesion is visible on the posterior lateral flank, deviating from the standard circular morphology of the surrounding spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible attached ventrally near the insertion point of the pectoral fin.
